content.short: MEXC is a global cryptocurrency exchange offering spot trading, perpetual futures, leveraged ETFs, NFT Index, portfolio management, and API access.
content.description: MEXC is a comprehensive cryptocurrency exchange designed for traders of all levels. It supports spot trading and perpetual futures, along with leveraged ETFs and an NFT Index, plus portfolio management tools to help organize holdings. The platform also offers API access so developers can pull market data and integrate endpoints into their dapps. With more than 7 million users worldwide, MEXC provides a broad, global trading community and robust features for active and institutional users alike.
content.meta: MEXC is a world-leading, user-friendly cryptocurrency exchange with spot markets and futures. Discover MEXC and other Trading Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
